items.title: Lawrence Cotton Interview, 1996-12-10
items.q: And we had a guy named Miller Sam

ctx.x: You had done reel-to-reel and done some recordings yourself?

No I would have had a recording of the band when we played, various places man, because we had a, Lloyd had a hell of a band out there man, it was like family. We had some fine musicians, they always, when one leaves somebody else would replace that guy. And we had a guy named Miller Sam, he's originally from Louisiana but he's been living in Detroit for the last 30 or 40 years. And he was a hell of a saxophone player. And his cousin, Gilbo, who played with Ray Charles, he came down there and had a guy we met in…
